summary: Dependency resolved from unpinned third-party GitHub repository
details: package.json declares the `libsignal` dependency as `github:RahmadTenpoles/libsignal-node` with no commit SHA, tag, or semver pin. On `npm install`, npm fetches the current HEAD of that repository's default branch and installs whatever it contains, including any lifecycle scripts inside the fetched tree. There is no integrity check and no version pinning, so the contents of the installed dependency can change at any time at the sole discretion of whoever controls the GitHub repository. The GitHub owner (RahmadTenpoles) is distinct from the npm publisher identity (FathulGans), so the dependency's code is governed by a third-party account rather than the package's own publisher.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
